newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed: Pliva, Karlovacka dominate.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed: Pliva, Karlovacka dominate.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed in sluggish business on Wednesday, with drugs firm Pliva and brewery Karlovacka Pivovara dominating trade.
* Of 13 issues three rose, five fell and five were flat.
* Volume fell to 10,375 from 12,489 units, turnover to 5.0 million kuna from 7.3 on Tuesday.
* Top gainer was electric cable maker Elka which added five kuna or 3.2 percent to 150 kuna on volume of 245 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Riviera lost four kuna or 2.6 percent percent to 146 with 328 shares sold.
* Pliva, selling 2,080 shares, was the most active issue, but it fell five kuna to 485 kuna.
For full closing details see page ZAGSTOCK. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
